_comment: Claude Code themes pfm install places into ~/.claude/themes/ (a user-level dir, shared by every project and, when their themes/ dirs are symlinked, by the fleet accounts). Two kinds. source_fetched: fetched at install from the theme's canonical public repo, always latest — the blueprint never vendors a copy. bundled: a profile, a `file` beside this manifest, read from the source clone or downloaded from beside the release manifest; with no `base` it is a complete palette (name, base, overrides), with `base` an overlay — only `name` and the differing `overrides` — written merged onto the fetched base. A bundled file's optional `surfaces` pins stay pfm's: install writes Claude's themes dir the name/base/overrides alone, and keeps the whole profile in pfm's install dir for `pfm theme` to read. Both kinds are recorded in the install ownership ledger; a recorded theme the manifest no longer lists is removed at the next install when unmodified. Activate with /theme, `pfm theme use {name}`, or set `theme` in an account's settings.json.

hibiscus-night.activate: /theme → "Hibiscus Night · everything pink"; per account: "theme": "custom:hibiscus-night", or pfm theme use hibiscus-night

lagoon.activate: /theme → "Lagoon · deep water, coral reef"; per account: "theme": "custom:lagoon", or pfm theme use lagoon

mirrorball.activate: /theme → "Mirrorball · disco glitter"; per account: "theme": "custom:mirrorball", or pfm theme use mirrorball

neon-sunset.activate: /theme → "Neon Sunset · synthwave dusk"; per account: "theme": "custom:neon-sunset", or pfm theme use neon-sunset

ultrafunk.activate: /theme → "Ultrafunk · blacklight disco"; per account: "theme": "custom:ultrafunk", or pfm theme use ultrafunk

velvet-groove.activate: /theme → "Velvet Groove · 70s funk lounge"; per account: "theme": "custom:velvet-groove", or pfm theme use velvet-groove
